title: Mac App by @Sn0wbrave: When you delete an app from the Mac, it leaves behind cache, settings,
notes:
When you delete an app from the Mac, it leaves behind cache, settings, and hidden files that silently accumulate for years. Purge removes the app along with all its remnants in one go, after displaying a list of every file, its size, and its security classification. Open

Designer: @Sn0wbrave. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
